[SWS_DM_01309] Unblock requests after
ara::diag::EcuResetRequest::ExecuteReset
completed
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04279
⌈
If UDS requests are blocked due to [SWS_DM_01022] and the
ara::core::Future
returned from the call of
ExecuteReset
, the DM shall
accept incoming UDS requests again.
⌋
7.3.2.8.6 Service 0x14 – ClearDiagnosticInformation
The UDS service
ClearDiagnosticInformation
is used to clear the ECUs fault
memory.
